title: fix(core): a rejecting sys_api_key read is the store outage (503), not "no key", so a cookie beside the key never answers for it
body:
Fixes #24299

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (a key whose read fails is no longer taken as "no key", so the request no longer falls on to another credential; owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue)

## What changes

`resolveApiKeyAdmission` (`packages/core/src/security/api-key.ts`) read the key's `sys_api_key` row inside a bare `catch` that answered `{ outcome: 'none' }` ("this request carries no key") and logged nothing. That `catch` now raises the branded `AuthzStoreUnavailableError('sys_api_key', err)`, the answer the same function already gave when its lifecycle-policy source (`api_key_policy`) or owner-posture source (`auth_gate`) rejects. The driver's error is kept as `cause`.

One read failure stays "no key": a `sys_api_key` table that was never provisioned, where no key can exist. That is the boundary the 2026-08-30 ruling (option A) draws for `resolveAuthzContext`'s `tryFind`, asked through the same shared `isMissingTableError(err, 'sys_api_key')`. No second classifier was added.

The other `outcome: 'none'` exits are unchanged and pinned: no key header, no engine, an engine with no `find`, no matching row, a row with no `user_id`.

No edit to `resolve-authz-context.ts` (fenced for PR #24373, `epic:#15194`) was needed. The throw leaves `resolveApiKeyAdmission` before the session arm runs, and every door already relays the branded outage as `503`.

## Measured first (M1), before the code changed

The same harness was run on three doors that admit keys, on `origin/main` `d65826fa7c` and again after the change. Each case is either the engine's `sys_api_key` read rejecting with every other table healthy (`key read rejects`), or every read rejecting (`all reject`). The key belongs to `u_key` and the cookie to a different user, `u_cookie`.

| door | fault | caller | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| REST `GET /api/v1/data/:object` (real route, single-kernel wiring) | key read rejects | key only | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| | | key + other user's cookie | **`200`, served as `u_cookie`** | `503`, data service never called |
| | | session only | `200` as `u_cookie` | unchanged |
| | all reject | key only / key + cookie / session | `401` / `503` / `503` | `503` / `503` / `503` |
| runtime dispatcher (`resolveRequestScope` + `GET /api/v1/automation/_status`) | key read rejects | key only | wire `401`, scope guest | wire `503`, raises `sys_api_key` |
| | | key + other user's cookie | **scope ran as `u_cookie`** (wire `501`, admitted) | wire `503`, raises `sys_api_key` |
| | | session only | scope `u_cookie` | unchanged |
| settings `GET /api/settings` (booted `SettingsServicePlugin`) | key read rejects | key only | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| | | key + other user's cookie | `200` (the session read answered) | `503`, session never read |
| | | session only | `200` | unchanged |

**The cookie-beside-a-failed-key reading is now measured. A request that led with a key was admitted as the principal of a cookie it did not lead with,** on the REST data door and the runtime dispatcher, and served on the settings door. The triage grade (6249028135) named this reading as the point to re-raise; that call is the lane's.

Hypotheses: H1 held (the throw alone gives every door measured `503`, through the handling the lifecycle-policy outage already takes). H2 held (the key-plus-cookie case answers `503` and the session is never read).

## Pins

- `packages/core/src/security/api-key-read-outage.test.ts` (new): a rejecting read raises the branded outage (`code`, `status`, `object`, `cause`). Through `resolveAuthzContext`, a key plus a cookie rejects and `getSession` is called zero times. A never-provisioned table (SQLite and Postgres spellings) is still `none`. A missing-table phrase naming another relation stays loud. The other `none` exits are unchanged, and a control admits the healthy key.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-api-key-read-outage.pin.test.ts` (new, door pin): the real REST data route. Key only answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Key plus cookie answers `503` and the data service is never called. Session only is unchanged. Controls: a healthy key is served as its owner, and an unprovisioned table answers `401`.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.api-key-read-outage.pin.test.ts` (new, door pin): `GET /api/settings` on the booted plugin, with the same rows as the REST pin. The session read count is 0 for key plus cookie.
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.tenancy-posture-outage.test.ts` (flipped by the sweep): the one existing pin that asserted the old answer. "A plain engine fault under a key degrades to a guest" now asserts the branded `sys_api_key` outage, with the superseded assertion quoted. Its intent, that every non-branded identity fault degrades to anonymous, moves to a session read that throws, which still resolves a guest.

Pin sweep: I searched the error code and message across the repo for pins with the same meaning, and ran the suites of every package whose tests send an API key while a read rejects (list below). Only the runtime pin above asserted the old answer. No existing pin asserted `401` on a door for a key whose read fails. `authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`'s `TRANSPORT_LEDGER` needs no row: it enumerates callers of `resolveAuthzContext`, and none was added.

## Verification record

Final head `3d826adf2` (merge base `c76e84922`).

- **Suites** (after the change, before the merge of `origin/main` `c76e8492`):
  - `@objectstack/core`: 104 files, 2551 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/rest`: 295 files, 6051 passed and 326 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/service-settings`: 50 files, 876 passed.
  - `@objectstack/service-storage`: 60 files, 1041 passed.
  - `@objectstack/service-datasource`: 45 files, 838 passed.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: 1 failed and 420 passed (421 files). The one red was the predicted pin above; after the flip that file reads 11 passed.
  - Targeted files in `cloud-connection` (41), `plugin-sharing` (31), `organizations` (32) and `plugin-auth` (11): all passed.
- **Ablation** (declared direction RED). `throw new AuthzStoreUnavailableError('sys_api_key', err);` was replaced by a `none` answer carrying the marker `ABLATION-24299`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (marker 1, anchor 0). `@objectstack/core` was then rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files. Result: 8 red, every control green.
  - core pin: 3 failed, 3 passed.
  - REST pin: 2 failed, 3 passed.
  - settings pin: 2 failed, 3 passed.
  - runtime pin: 1 failed, 10 passed.

  Restore: blob equals HEAD (`13e1cdc2035`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, core was rebuilt, and the `--absent` preflight exited 0 with the tree clean. A first attempt used a comment marker, which the build strips. Its preflight refused, so that leg's readings were discarded and the leg was re-run with a string marker.
- **Typecheck**, after the merge of `origin/main`: core, rest, runtime and service-settings all exit 0. `--listFiles` shows each new test compiled: `tsconfig.test.json` for core, rest and runtime, `tsconfig.json` for settings.
- **Gates**, on `3d826adf2`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths derived 69 commands. All 69 exited 0, and each exit code was captured before any pipe. `--ran` reads 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - The first pass, before the last test commit, turned up three real findings in the new tests, all corrected before that commit: `check-rest-log-spy-declared` (the REST pin now declares `OS_REST_LOG`), `check:objectql-double-limit` (a `find` double the probe could not drive), and `check:where-matcher` (two matchers that read a combinator as a field; both now refuse).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 because some dist was missing. After a whole-tree build (76 of 76 tasks) it exited 0.
  - Also: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 5 changed `.ts` files exited 0, and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `resolveApiKeyPrincipal`, the principal-or-nothing collapse, now raises the outage too instead of answering `undefined`. Its docblock says so. Its only in-repo users are re-exports. No caller in this repo catches its throw differently from the admission's.
- The storage family's ADR-0069 gate reader calls `resolveApiKeyAdmission` directly. It had the same fall-through: with `none`, it went on to read the session's posture. The throw now reaches its door as the branded outage, which its comment already says the door relays as `503`. Its suite is green.
- One changeset, on `@objectstack/core` (`minor`, breaking, `no-migration-prescription`). The rest, runtime and settings diffs are tests only, which no package publishes.
